name: Gaming
metaDescription: Gaming sound buttons: victory jingles, coin pickups, level-up chimes and rage-inducing defeat sounds. Play instantly, download free.
intro:
Every gamer knows these sounds before they can name them: the coin pickup, the level-up chime, the defeat buzzer that haunts your dreams. The gaming soundboard collects them as instant buttons for your Discord calls, stream alerts and video edits.

Tap to play, download the MP3 free, or embed a button straight into your stream overlay. We keep this board growing with whatever is trending in gaming clips right now, so if a sound is echoing across Twitch and YouTube Gaming this week, it lands here.

faq.q: Can I use these sounds in my Discord server?
faq.a: Yes. Download the MP3 and upload it to your server's soundboard, or play Bleepboard in the browser and route it through your mic input.

faq.q: Do these work as stream alert sounds?
faq.a: They do. Download the MP3 and drop it into OBS, Streamlabs or your alert tool of choice.
